cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(goose_http_native LANGUAGES C)
find_package(CURL 7.85 REQUIRED)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
add_library(goose_http_native STATIC native/http.c)
set_target_properties(goose_http_native PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_compile_features(goose_http_native PRIVATE c_std_11)
target_compile_options(goose_http_native PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wframe-larger-than=16384)
target_link_libraries(goose_http_native PUBLIC CURL::libcurl Threads::Threads)
